none: PAS WILT-FDB1CB: Roman brooch Colchester type
contea di ritrovamento: Bath and North East Somerset (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper alloy Roman Dolphin type or Colchester derivative type, brooch dating to the period c. AD 43 - 100. The pin and part of the hinge mechanism are missing. The remainder of the brooch is complete except for some slight damage to the head. The brooch measures 53.97mm in length, 28.72mm maximum width (across the wings), and weighs 10.13g.
